overview.name: Schwab High Yield Bond ETF
overview.description: The index tracks the performance of U.S. dollar denominated below investment grade corporate debt (junk bonds), currently in a coupon paying period, that is publicly issued in the U.S. domestic market. It is the fund’s policy that under normal circumstances it will invest at least 80% of its net assets in below investment grade bonds.
